hub.pageDescription: Your tutor profile, verification status and the next step.
hub.heading: Become a tutor
hub.subheading: Set up your tutor profile, tell learners what you teach and get verified so they can book one-to-one and small-group classes with you.

createProfile.title: Create your tutor profile
createProfile.body: Tell learners who you are and what you teach. It takes a few minutes and stays a private draft until you send it for verification.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.body: A few things are still missing before you can ask for verification. The checklist shows exactly what.

startVerification.title: Verify your identity
startVerification.body: Your profile is ready. Next, accept the privacy consent and upload the documents we need to confirm who you are and what you are qualified to teach.

continueVerification.body: Your verification request is open. Upload the required documents and send it for review.

awaitingReview.body: Our team is checking your documents. You will receive an email and a notification when there is a decision. Your documents are locked while they are reviewed.

needsInfo.body: The review team asked for something more. Read their message below, update your documents and send the request again.

rejected.title: Verification was not approved
rejected.body: Your request was not approved. Read the reason below; if you can fix it, you can submit a new request.

verified.title: You are a verified tutor
verified.body: Your profile has been verified. Open your listing when you are ready to appear in tutor search and receive bookings.

suspended.title: Your tutor account is suspended
suspended.body: Your profile is hidden and you cannot take new bookings. Read the reason below, and contact support if you think this is a mistake.

verificationUnavailable.title: Verification is not available yet

availability.pageDescription: Set when learners can book you, your days off and the booking rules
availability.heading: Availability
availability.subheading: Choose the hours you teach each week, your days off or extra days, and the booking rules. Learners only see the times the system works out as truly free. All times are Thailand time.

settings.heading: Booking rules

rules.heading: Weekly teaching hours
rules.intro: Add hours to each day; learners can only book inside them. Times are Thailand time (UTC+7). To run past midnight, choose an end time earlier than the start time.

violation.too_many: There are too many windows for this day or this week

exceptions.heading: Days off and extra days
exceptions.intro: Close a whole day or part of one, or open extra hours on a day you normally do not teach. A closure always wins over opened hours.

2026-10-v1.title: Consent to collect and verify identity documents (PDPA)
2026-10-v1.purpose: We collect your national ID card, your qualification documents and a criminal-record certificate only to confirm who you are and that you are suitable to teach learners on this platform, including children.
2026-10-v1.data: These documents contain personal data, including your national ID number, and the criminal-record certificate may contain sensitive information. You choose what to upload; please do not send documents we did not ask for.
2026-10-v1.access: Your files are encrypted when stored. Only authorised members of our review team can open them, one file at a time, and every time a file is opened it is recorded. Nobody else, including learners, can see them. You will not be able to view a file again after you upload it.
2026-10-v1.retention: After the review decision your ID card and criminal-record certificate are deleted within 30 days, and your other documents within 90 days. We keep only the outcome of the review, its date and who decided.
2026-10-v1.rights: You may withdraw this consent or ask us to delete your data at any time by contacting us. Without your documents we cannot verify you, so you could not teach as a tutor.
